import curses

MOVES = {curses.KEY_UP: (-1, 0), curses.KEY_DOWN: (1, 0),
         curses.KEY_LEFT: (0, -1), curses.KEY_RIGHT: (0, 1)}

def main(screen):
    screen.keypad(True)
    screen.timeout(120)
    height, width = screen.getmaxyx()
    if height < 5 or width < 10:
        return
    row, col = height // 2, width // 2
    dr, dc = 0, 1
    score = 0
    collectibles = set()
    while True:
        screen.erase()
        screen.addnstr(0, 0, f'Arrows to steer, q to quit, Score: {score}', width - 1)
        screen.addch(row, col, '@')
        for r, c in collectibles:
            screen.addch(r, c, '*')
        screen.refresh()
        key = screen.getch()
        if key == ord('q'):
            return
        dr, dc = MOVES.get(key, (dr, dc))
        nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc
        if not (1 <= nr < height - 1 and 0 <= nc < width - 1):
            screen.addnstr(0, 0, 'Game over', width - 1)
            screen.refresh()
            screen.getch()
            return
        if (nr, nc) not in collectibles:
            score += 1
            collectibles.add((nr, nc))
        row, col = nr, nc

import curses

MOVES = {curses.KEY_UP: (-1, 0), curses.KEY_DOWN: (1, 0),
         curses.KEY_LEFT: (0, -1), curses.KEY_RIGHT: (0, 1)}

def main(screen):
    screen.keypad(True)
    screen.timeout(120)
    height, width = screen.getmaxyx()
    if height < 5 or width < 10:
        return
    row, col = height // 2, width // 2
    dr, dc = 0, 1
    score = 0
    food = (height // 2, width // 2)
    while True:
        screen.erase()
        screen.addnstr(0, 0, f'Arrows to steer, q to quit, Score: {score}', width - 1)
        screen.addch(row, col, '@')
        screen.addch(food[0], food[1], '*')
        screen.refresh()
        key = screen.getch()
        if key == ord('q'):
            return
        dr, dc = MOVES.get(key, (dr, dc))
        nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc
        if not (1 <= nr < height - 1 and 0 <= nc < width - 1):
            screen.addnstr(0, 0, 'Game over', width - 1)
            screen.refresh()
            screen.getch()
            return
        if (nr, nc) == food:
            score += 1
            food = (height // 2, width // 2)
        row, col = nr, nc
